answer: A California real-estate licence check makes each extra identity pay about $515 — 135 course hours, a $60 exam and a $245 licence fee; a farm running N fakes pays N×$515 and cannot share it because one licence number names one person and backs one seat. The cost climbs a terrace of three steps, and the DRE registry is a beacon anyone can query. Each licence leaves a vine of filings a farm must grow one by one. A farm cloning one licence dies by registry cross-check at 2: the second seat on one licence number flags both and burns both seats.
